text:
The urge to upgrade your tools or software often hits during a period of intense productivity. However, when your calendar is already overflowing, adding a new system can actually do more harm than good. 

A new upgrade requires a learning curve, and right now, you don't have the cognitive bandwidth to master a new interface. Instead of fighting the friction of a new setup during a busy season, wait until the dust settles. Stability is more valuable than novelty when you're running at capacity.
